channel.title: Business Insider Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Africa (africa.businessinsider.com)

item.title: Amid travel warnings and penalties, the U.S. quietly opens 1,000+ visa slots for Ghanaians
item.description: In a period marred by visa restrictions and diplomatic tensions between the West and Africa, the United States Embassy has opened up an opportunity for Non-Immigrant Visa Appointments for Ghanaian citizens.

item.title: Dangote signs separate $750 million deals with Chinese and Indian companies to expand refinery
item.description: Dangote Group has made significant strides in expanding its refinery and petrochemical operations with two major agreements, collectively worth $750 million.

item.title: Africa's richest man appoints daughters to oversee key Dangote Group operations
item.description: Africa's richest man, Aliko Dangote, has appointed his daughters to senior leadership positions within the Dangote Group.

item.title: FULL LIST: 12 countries driving West Africa’s long-delayed Eco currency rollout
item.description: Governors of central banks from 12 West African countries have convened in Monrovia, Liberia, to accelerate preparations for the long-awaited launch of the Eco regional currency, marking one of the strongest signals yet that the project may finally move from blueprint to implementation.

item.title: From hosting Nigeria’s leader to visiting Ethiopia’s PM, Turkey is expanding its African reach
item.description: The president of Turkey, Recep Tayyip Erdogan, has yet again made another significant move on the African continent in the span of the year so far.

item.title: Nigeria launches formal probe into Temu
item.description: Nigeria has opened a full investigation into Temu, escalating concerns about how the fast-fashion marketplace collects and manages user data in one of Africa’s most active digital economies.

item.title: MTN to acquire IHS Towers in $6.2bn deal, take tower giant private
item.description: MTN Group has agreed to acquire the remaining stake in IHS Towers that it does not already own, in an all-cash transaction that values the tower operator at approximately $6.2 billion.

item.title: 10 African countries with the highest IMF debt in February 2026
item.description: Africa's growing reliance on International Monetary Fund (IMF) loans is gaining traction as governments battle with escalating debt burdens and budgetary restrictions.

item.title: Aliko Dangote calls for emergency power summit as blackouts threaten Nigeria’s $500bn economy
item.description: Africa’s richest businessman, Aliko Dangote, has issued a blunt warning to Nigeria’s government: without stable electricity, the country’s industrial ambitions will stall.

item.title: Africa's largest oil producer misses OPEC targets, forfeits $1.31 billion in revenue as production woes deepen
item.description: Nigeria forfeited an estimated $1.31bn in potential crude oil revenue between January 2025 and January 2026 after repeatedly failing to meet its production quota set by the Organisation of the Petroleum Exporting Countries, according to official data.
